limitations: PASS confirms recorded computation/provenance and independent timing arithmetic; it does not establish improved accuracy or independent generalization.
CPU6 replay was performed by ROOT workers; this review checks their exact receipts and bindings, not a second numerical replay.
Whole V independent rescoring is an exact prior audit reused; V43 is development reuse. New CPU6 parity is a separate checkpoint test.
LoRA accuracy remains the original .25epoch LIMITED_SCREEN, not a converged or matched-three-epoch baseline.
CPU active_adapter_MiB in the original memory API counts GPU bytes; a zero there does not mean the CPU adapter occupies zero memory.
Physical history/mask hashes match recorded existing B2 and fresh R5a/R5b cost inputs; raw histories were not numerically reconstructed by this review.
Resource peaks are sampled external-guard observations. Nonoverlap is proven for eight observed owned cost windows; absence of unrelated host activity was not independently re-observed here.
Stage probes are intrusive and remain separate; their stage sums are not asserted to equal uninstrumented whole-pipeline timing.
Opaque file hashing/ZIP byte I/O can touch protected compressed bytes while the prefix loader converts only pre-T numeric values.
